full_description: Dried game fibres and parched maize are combined for mobile Indigenous travel and exchange.
taste: Smoky lean meat contrasts with crisp, sweet, mineral corn.

full_description: Indigenous chile, cacao, seeds, and introduced ingredients form a complex colonial New Spanish sauce over poultry.
taste: Bitter, nutty, sweet, smoky, and fiery flavours layer over rich meat.

full_description: Wheat bread technique and sugar join Indigenous cacao in a New Spanish urban bakery.
taste: Soft yeast crumb carries bitter chocolate, caramel sweetness, and spice.

full_description: Introduced pork fills an Indigenous nixtamal maize parcel steamed in leaves.
taste: Sweet mineral corn surrounds rich meat, chile heat, and aromatic sauce.

full_description: Introduced cheese and Indigenous chile fill maize dough in a colonial contact-zone preparation.
taste: Tangy melted curd and bright heat enrich sweet, steamed corn.

full_description: Indigenous pit cooking adapts introduced livestock, whose juices are caught below as rich broth.
taste: Smoky tender meat and concentrated stock carry herbs and chile warmth.

full_description: Native sweet potato simmers in introduced cane sugar syrup for an urban New Spanish sweet.
taste: Earthy softness carries dark caramel, spice, and glossy sweetness.

full_description: Iberian almond paste is darkened with Indigenous cacao in a colonial confectioner's workshop.
taste: Nutty richness and floral sugar balance deep chocolate bitterness.

full_description: Native potato and introduced cheese bake beneath pastry in an Andean colonial contact dish.
taste: Earthy tuber, tangy curd, and crisp wheat taste rich and mellow.

full_description: Native tubers receive a creamy introduced-cheese sauce sharpened by Indigenous chile.
taste: Soft earthiness meets tangy richness, bright heat, and salt.

full_description: Highland freeze-dried potato is bound with introduced eggs into a browned colonial-era cake.
taste: Mineral starch and rich egg taste smoky, earthy, and peppered.

full_description: A durable aromatic cake is sliced beside communal punch in an early modern tavern.
taste: Caraway-like spice and buttery crumb temper sweet citrus-like warmth.

full_description: Cured meat and sharp pickle fill a sturdy hot pie sold alongside bowls of punch.
taste: Salty meat, sour relish, pepper, and crisp pastry taste robust.

full_description: Salt meat, ship biscuit, and adopted potatoes boil together into a practical sailor's dish.
taste: Brine, soft starch, and sour bread carry old fat and pepper.

full_description: Boiled dough layers alternate with salt meat in a lidded shipboard pot rather than an oven.
taste: Dense pastry absorbs briny meat liquor and savoury fat.

full_description: Chopped salt meat, fish, pickles, eggs, and available greens form a composed cold sailor's dish.
taste: Brine, sourness, rich egg, and sharp greens create lively variety.

full_description: British company households combine Indian rice-and-pulse technique with flaked fish and egg.
taste: Fragrant grain, briny flakes, rich egg, and mild spice mingle.

full_description: South Indian pepper-water traditions are expanded with meat for British company dining.
taste: Sharp spice and sourness enliven clear stock, meat, and herbs.

full_description: Sweet-sour spiced fruit preserve is spread on toasted bread in an Anglo-Indian household.
taste: Tart fruit, sugar, chile heat, and crisp wheat strike vividly.

full_description: Spiced preserved meat is enclosed in pastry for officers familiar with South Asian sauces.
taste: Aromatic heat, salt meat, and rich gravy penetrate the crust.

short_description: pickle toast for the tea table
full_description: Thin buttered toast carries crisp sour pickle as a sharp accompaniment before later sandwich conventions.
taste: Acidic crunch, butter, and browned wheat taste light and savoury.

full_description: Flaky pastry encloses spiced mince for sale in an urban chocolate-house refreshment room.
taste: Buttery layers release rich meat, pepper, and sweet aromatic spice.

full_description: Dark plantation molasses enriches a hard maritime biscuit within Atlantic provisioning networks.
taste: Bitter caramel sweetness softens dry wheat, salt, and heavy toast.

full_description: Beans are boiled into a minimal ration within the violent coercive system of the slave trade.
taste: Watery earthy pulse tastes smoky, undersalted, and bleakly plain.

full_description: Enriched crescent-shaped pastry encloses ground nuts for a fashionable central European coffee room.
taste: Buttery yeast layers surround roasted filling, spice, and gentle sweetness.

full_description: A fine egg-rich almond cake is sliced thin for an affluent eighteenth-century tea table.
taste: Moist nut crumb tastes buttery, floral, and cleanly sweet.

short_description: a chilled pale roux working ball
full_description: Butter and flour are cooked together but remain a concentrated thickener awaiting dilution into sauce.
Repeated folds trap butter between raw dough layers that still require shaping and baking.

short_description: a bowl of warm choux paste
full_description: Cooked flour paste mixed with raw egg awaits piping and thorough oven baking.

short_description: a bowl of unbaked meringue foam
full_description: Whipped raw egg white and sugar hold stiff peaks but remain unsafe before drying.

short_description: a vessel of unfrozen custard base
full_description: Rich egg-and-cream custard is chilled but awaits freezing and churning in salt ice.
Raw flour, fat, egg, and fruit are bound inside cloth before prolonged boiling.
Highly concentrated stock remains sticky and moist before final drying into durable cakes.
Cacao, sugar, and spice form a gritty working mass requiring further grinding and moulding.
Coffee-flavoured butter dough is rolled and cut but has not yet been baked crisp.

short_description: a bowl of proving tea-cake dough
full_description: Enriched yeasted dough with fruit is rising before shaping and baking for tea service.

short_description: a bowl of raw potato dumpling mixture
full_description: Grated potato and binder are mixed for dumplings but remain uncooked and unsafe.

short_description: a pan of unfinished tomato conserve
full_description: Chopped adopted tomatoes are only partly reduced and require further cooking before preservation.

short_description: a bundle of soaking salt cod
full_description: Heavily cured cod remains in water to shed salt and has not been cooked for eating.
Raw dough and uncooked salt-meat layers fill a shipboard pot awaiting prolonged boiling.
Thin dough and raw meat filling form a spiral that still requires full baking.
Perfumed sugar starch remains hot and uncut before setting, powdering, and final drying.

short_description: raw meat in Mughal kebab marinade
full_description: Meat pieces absorb sour dairy and spice but remain raw before skewering and grilling.

short_description: a bowl of uncooked curry spice paste
full_description: Raw onion, ground aromatics, and oil form a concentrated company-kitchen base awaiting cooking.

short_description: a cured duck awaiting tea smoke
full_description: A salted raw duck is dried and prepared for smoking but remains unsafe to eat.

short_description: a tray of cooling vinegared rice
full_description: Seasoned rice cools under a cloth before receiving cured fish and final shaping.

short_description: a tub of salted kimchi cabbage
full_description: Cabbage is wilting under salt before seasoning and controlled fermentation make it ready.
Grated cassava remains under pressure while harmful liquid drains away before safe cooking.
Alkali-treated maize is only coarsely ground and requires finishing before shaping and cooking.
Elastic hot sugar is stretched for table decoration but has not cooled or hardened safely.
Impurities skimmed during plantation sugar refining form a bitter industrial by-product, not food.
